control_plans.request: Transform the man’s phone call in the beige leather car interior into digital glitch art, with high-contrast shadows and RGB color separation across his navy suit, seats, and window reflections. Apply horizontal pixel shifts, fragmented blocks, and flickering scan-line textures across the entire frame, with distorted color highlights.

input.prompt: Transform this entire shot into bold digital glitch art. Keep the recognizable man making his phone call, his navy suit, the beige leather car seats, the window reflections, and the original framing and natural movements. Apply deep high-contrast shadows with distorted electric cyan, magenta, red, green, and blue highlights. Visibly separate the RGB channels along the man's silhouette, suit lapels, seat seams, headrests, and reflected buildings. Animate horizontal pixel shifts and displaced image strips across the full frame, with intermittent fragmented rectangular blocks that briefly repeat and offset pieces of the underlying image. Layer fine flickering scan lines and digital interference over the man, seats, and windows throughout the clip. Vary the glitch bands and blocks rapidly over time, with occasional stronger bursts of horizontal tearing, while keeping the man's face, hand, and phone identifiable and the phone-call action continuous. Make the result a cohesive, vivid corrupted-video artwork with crisp pixel edges and chromatic ghosting.

payload.prompt: Add conspicuous animated digital tearing and rectangular fragmentation to this neon glitch-art phone-call shot. Preserve its saturated RGB separation, deep black shadows, distorted electric highlights, and recognizable man holding his phone inside the car. Break the image into sharply bounded horizontal strips that visibly jump left and right: portions of the face, suit lapels, seat seams, headrests, and window reflections become temporarily misaligned, then snap back. Use several thick displaced bands interspersed with fine flickering scan lines. Scatter distinct rectangular fragments containing duplicated, offset pieces of the actual image across the suit, seats, and windows. Give these blocks crisp pixel edges, contrasting RGB offsets, and visibly displaced internal details. The fragments should flash, change position, and disappear in irregular bursts throughout the entire clip. Keep most of the scene readable between the disrupted regions, with the man's face, hand, and phone identifiable and his natural phone-call movement continuous. Maintain the original camera framing. Make both the horizontal displacement and rectangular blocks clearly visible at normal viewing size, integrated with the existing vivid color treatment.
